## H3 Video Upsampler (file to file)

Same result as the IMAGE workflow, for clips of any length on any machine: the video is read, upscaled and saved **a piece at a time**, so RAM stays low however long it is.

1. **Load Video**: pick the clip. Frame rate and sound come from the file.
2. **Queue.** The MP4 lands in `video/H3_upsampled` with the original soundtrack.

**Models**

| loader | file | folder |
|---|---|---|
| Load Diffusion Model | [`minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) for `regen2k`; [`minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot.safetensors) (no LoRAs) for `ic` | `diffusion_models` |
| Load CLIP (optional, `ic` only) | [`qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) | `text_encoders` |
| Video VAE | [`minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (about 20% faster overall, slightly softer hair edges: [`minimax_h3_sol_vae_fp16`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_sol_vae_fp16.safetensors)) | `vae` |
| Audio VAE | [`minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) | `vae` |
| `upscale_model` | [`minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/blob/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors), save it as `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors` | `latent_upscale_models` |
| `lora` for `regen2k` | [`open_h3_regenerate_2k_r256pp_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/sandpies/ComfyUI-H3-Video-Upsampler/blob/main/lora/open_h3_regenerate_2k_r256pp_bf16.safetensors) | `loras` |
| `ic` only | [`minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_ic_lora_avg_rank_21_bf16`](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_ic_lora_avg_rank_21_bf16.safetensors) (200 MB) + [`minimax_h3_hyperflow_8step_v1.0`](https://huggingface.co/videorebirth/hyperflow/blob/main/minimax_h3_hyperflow_8step_v1.0.safetensors) (+ [`minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64`](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64.safetensors) if you have it) | `loras` |

### Settings worth knowing
- **method**: `regen2k` (default) re-draws detail from the enlarged clip. `ic` keeps each piece's original frames in view while it re-draws and hears the soundtrack, so faces, lettering and mouths stay the clip's own; it is slower. For `ic`, switch **Load Diffusion Model** to `minimax_h3_ref2va_int8_convrot` (no LoRAs); the node stops before any work and says so if the model cannot run it. Load CLIP is optional for `ic`: unwired, a saved encoding of the task is used and the 26 GB text encoder never loads.
- **megapixels**: output size (2 = about 1920x1080).
- **denoise**: how strongly detail is re-drawn. 0.8 = normal, 0 = only enlarge.
- **redraw_start** (`regen2k`): how much the re-draw may change. **0.6** (default) keeps faces close to your clip; 0.8 = the original recipe, sharper but faces drift more.
- **redraw_steps**: 3 = the recipe; 2 = about a third faster and starts later, so less is re-drawn (also for `ic`).
- **tile_tokens**: leave at 0 (automatic: it learns what your GPU can take).
- **chunk_join**: leave on `stepped`: long clips are cut into overlapping pieces re-drawn together, so there are no seams.
- **chunking / tiling**: leave on. They only split the work when your GPU needs it.
- **attention**: `sparse` (default) is about 28% faster and looked the same in tests; `dense` is exact but slower.
- **conditioning** (optional, `regen2k`): a text prompt describing the look. Unwired works well for most clips.
- **frame_rate**: `24 (H3 native)` converts to 24 fps while reading: exact lip sync and half the work for 48 fps clips. Add `frame_gen` x2 to get 48 fps back.
- **frame_gen / codec / quality**: how the MP4 is saved. x2 doubles the frame rate (RTX + `nvidia-vfx`).
- **reuse_encoded**: re-running the same clip with other settings starts faster.
